depth_calibration.method: two constraints, two unknowns: face anchor + torso depth spread

geometry: displaced silhouette shell, flat back cap, stitched side walls
world_axes: +X right, +Y away from camera, +Z up; actor centred at Y=0
limits: no eye sockets at true depth, no ears in the round, no hair strands, invented back. Self-shadowing is right in the large and wrong in fine detail.
